top_signals.title: Brazil Real Nears Post-Vote Low as Dovish Minutes Add Pressure
top_signals.summary: The Brazilian real sank on Tuesday, nearing levels seen after Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s surprise re-election as traders saw few signs the nation’s central bank is willing to raise interest rates even amid mounting inflation pressures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Report: Russian ships are pumping tanks, MRAPs and rocket launchers into Africa
top_signals.summary: Russian cargo ships have carried military equipment including tanks, armored vehicles and rocket launchers to African ports serving as gateways to Moscow’s forces on the continent, according to a new investigation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
